extDescription.message: Capture an entire web page, scrolling included, or an area you select as an image, then download or copy it.

actionTitle.message: Capture the full page or a selected area

areaHint.message: Drag to select an area. Press Esc to cancel.

splitNotice.message: This page is too tall for a single image, so it was split top to bottom into $COUNT$ images.

infiniteScrollNotice.message: This page keeps loading more content as you scroll (for example, infinite scroll), so the capture stopped after $COUNT$ screens.

tooLongNotice.message: This page is very long, so only the first $COUNT$ screens were captured.

errorRestricted.message: Chrome doesn't let extensions capture this page. Browser pages (chrome://), the Chrome Web Store and some built-in viewers are protected. For local files, turn on "Allow access to file URLs" for this extension on chrome://extensions.

errorTabHidden.message: The capture stopped because another tab was brought to the front. Stay on the page until the capture finishes, then try again.

errorNotFound.message: This screenshot is no longer available. Only the $COUNT$ most recent screenshots are kept.

errorFailed.message: Something went wrong while capturing the page. Reload the page and try again.
